content.value: A steel tube with 5 cm inner diameter, 7.6 cm outer diameter and $k = 1 5 W / m . ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ is covered with an insulative covering of thickness t = 2 cm and $k = 0 . 2 W / m . ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ A hot gas at $T _ { \alpha } =$ $3 3 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } , h _ { a } = 4 0 0 W / m ^ { 2 }$ .°C flows inside the tube. The outer surface of the insulation is exposed to cooler air at $T _ { b } = 3 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ ,with $h _ { b } = 6 0 W / m ^ { 2 }$ .C.
